clauses.reason: Amends section 4(b) of EO 12687 by replacing the date December 31, 1991 with December 31, 1992. As amended, the section ends the Committee on that date unless it was extended first, and no held source shows an extension. First end by the order's own terms: 1992-12-31, inclusive (the exclusive reading, that the Committee ends when that day begins, is the alternative). EO 12869 section 4(e), effective 1993-09-30, later revokes the parent as amended by this order and is recorded as a later event.

research_rationale:
EO 12785 of December 26, 1991 (Extending the President's Education Policy Advisory Committee), read in full in the held Federal Register text (56 FR 67451, Federal Register of December 30, 1991; machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1991-12-26). The single sentence amends section 4(b) of EO 12687, as amended, by deleting the date December 31, 1991 and inserting the date December 31, 1992. Own-terms end: section 4(b) of EO 12687 (54 FR 34127, held Federal Register text) reads "The Committee shall terminate on December 31, 1990, unless sooner" (the word "extended" follows on the next line); EO 12741 (56 FR 475) moved that date to December 31, 1991 and this order moved it to December 31, 1992. The Committee therefore terminated by the section's own terms on December 31, 1992, unless an extension issued first. The sunset is self-executing and needs no separate record of lapse. A by-number search of the held order texts for EO 12687 found EO 12687 itself, EO 12741, EO 12785 and EO 12869 (each in its Federal Register text, and EO 12741, EO 12785 and EO 12869 also in their American Presidency Project copies), the Federal Register file EO_12868 (a page range that overlaps EO 12869) and a U.S. Code note under 20 U.S.C. 1221 that records the order and its amendments without any extension beyond 1992. No held text extends the Committee past December 31, 1992. Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) an amendment normally continues until its parent ends; this amendment's only content is the Committee's run to December 31, 1992, so its first end is that date, recorded inclusive as the owner's until-date ruling (2026-10-21) directs; the exclusive reading (the Committee ends when that day begins) is the alternative a reviewer should see. Later event, after the end: EO 12869 section 4(e) (signed 1993-09-30, effective under its section 6 on September 30, 1993; 58 FR 51751, Federal Register of October 4, 1993) revokes EO 12687, as amended by EO 12741 and EO 12785, among the orders that established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed (its words are recorded in the quoted source span); it names EO 12785 and is a clean-up of an order that had already ended. Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning.
